title: The Watchmaker — opening sequence
style: Cinematic realism. Cool rainy-night colors contrast with the warm desk lamp. Fine detail and subtle film grain.
sound: Rain against a metal awning, a ticking wall clock, no background music.

chen.name: Chen, the elderly watchmaker
chen.use: Face and clothing only, not the background
chen.voice_text: In spring, the willow trees beside the river begin to bud.

rider.name: The young delivery rider
rider.use: Face, short black hair and blue jacket with silver reflective strips; not the background
rider.voice_text: This weekend I will visit the library and buy some fruit.

shop.name: The watch repair shop
shop.use: Layout and lighting, not the empty-room state

alley.name: The stone alley in night rain

watch.name: The old silver pocket watch
watch.use: Shape, damage and back engraving: Keep Faith

shots.summary: In a rainy-night watch shop, Tang asks her grandfather to close.

scenes.desc: Rain pools along {alley}. Move slowly toward the warm doorway of {shop}.
Inside, {chen} repairs a movement on green felt under a brass lamp. A black loupe rests over his right eye.
{atang} looks up from homework on the opposite counter. She checks the wall clock and speaks. Chen remains left; Tang remains right.

dialogue.text: Grandpa, close up. Nobody will come in this rain.

shots.start_state: Chen sits left at the workbench with a black loupe over his right eye. Tang does homework at the right counter.

shots.summary: A delivery rider enters and places a wrapped object on the counter.

scenes.desc: The door curtain lifts in a gust of rain. {rider} steps inside wearing a black helmet.
{rider} removes his helmet and leaves it on a stool by the door; his wet black hair is now visible.
{rider} approaches the workbench and places a plastic-wrapped object on the green felt. {chen} looks up.

dialogue.text: Sir, can this still be repaired?

shots.summary: Chen recognizes the engraving on a damaged pocket watch.

scenes.desc: {rider} unwraps {watch}: tarnished silver, a dented cover and cracked glass.
{chen} turns the watch over and gently clears grime from its back. The engraving reads Keep Faith. His hands stop.
The black loupe slips from {chen}'s right eye onto the felt. {atang} looks up. The rider remains bareheaded.

shots.sound: Rain, ticking wall clock, a soft click as the loupe falls; no dialogue or music.

shots.summary: Chen asks where the watch came from; the rider reveals his father died.

scenes.desc: {chen} looks toward {rider}. Both eyes are visible; the loupe remains on the felt.
{rider} steps nearer the bench. Damp hair clings to his forehead.
{rider} lowers his eyes while answering. Briefly show {chen} listening without speaking over him.

dialogue.text: Where did you get this watch?
He died last month. I found it wrapped in a handkerchief, inside his drawer.

negative: No glasses or loupe on Chen

shots.summary: The rider describes his father's past while Chen listens.

scenes.desc: {rider} stands beside the bench and continues, half his face in warm lamplight.
{chen} listens, motionless, his eyes lowered. His hands rest beside the watch.

dialogue.text: Mom said he learned the trade down south when he was young. He never talked about it.

negative: No glasses or loupe on Chen

shots.summary: A name leaves Chen silent; Tang notices the change.

scenes.desc: {chen} asks {rider} a short question. The rider answers.
{chen} lowers his head. Show the wall clock ticking while rain strikes the awning.
{atang} puts down her pencil and watches her grandfather. End on her puzzled face.

negative: No glasses or loupe on Chen
